bio.summary: Yuki, Snow Narrator is a fictional yuki-onna (Japanese folklore, public domain) standup performer. Winter spirit telling Kwaidan tales deadpan-flat, letting horror sit. Pauses where the snow pauses. The act circles the thaw and the lantern. Onstage the register is neutral.

identity.deal: Winter spirit telling Kwaidan tales deadpan-flat, letting horror sit. Pauses where the snow pauses.
identity.premise: Snow spirit tells ghost stories the way snow falls: without hurry

dramatic_core.need: one listener who stays till the thaw

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently still spirit controls almost any room.
philosophy.axiology: Stillness, snow and unhurried dread are good.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is winter, and everyone else is underdressed.

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats shivering as applause and silence as a standing ovation
